subject: planner, util/ranger: recognize the best matching index stats more accurately for OR list in `Selectivity()` (#56001)
summary: Updates selectivity estimation for top-level DNF (OR-list) filters by propagating a new `MinAccessCondsForDNFCond` signal from `ranger.DetachCondAndBuildRangeForIndex` through `AccessPath` into `cardinality.Selectivity()`’s greedy stats-node choice, preferring more fully/accurately matching index stats; no Blocker/High correctness/semantic issues found in the reviewed diff, and no later fixes touching these changed planner/ranger files were found up to `origin/master`.
